techniques.name: PowerShell
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

techniques.name: Windows Command Shell
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may steal data by transferring it over an existing command and control channel.

techniques.name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
techniques.description: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding an entry to the Run or RunOnce registry keys.

techniques.name: System Owner/User Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to identify the primary user, currently logged-in user, or system owner.

techniques.name: System Information Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware.

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may enumerate files and directories or search for specific information on file systems.

techniques.name: Process Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get information about running processes on a system.

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifier.

techniques.name: Account Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a list of local system or domain accounts.

techniques.name: Web Protocols
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web traffic (HTTP/HTTPS).

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.description: Adversaries may transfer tools or other files from an external system into a compromised environment.

techniques.name: File Deletion
techniques.description: Adversaries may delete files left behind by the actions of their malware or tooling.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.description: Adversaries may dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or script difficult to discover or analyze.

techniques.name: Disable or Modify Tools
techniques.description: Adversaries may modify and/or disable security software or antivirus tools.
